Adapting Farms Using NASA Data

Description:

Develop a smart agriculture solution that uses NASA satellite data and Earth observation technologies to help farmers adapt to changing climate conditions. The system analyzes satellite-based information such as rainfall, temperature, soil moisture, drought conditions, and vegetation health to provide useful insights. It helps farmers make informed decisions about crop selection, irrigation, and farming practices, improving agricultural productivity
summary:
